posts.author: shimmermathlabs.com
posts.text:
i was gonna joke proof won't fit, but it does actually.

ζ(1) = 1 + ½ + (⅓ + ¼) + (⅕ + ⋯ + ⅛) + ⋯

each bracket has twice as many terms as the last, each at least half as large as its last term. more simply: block k has 2ᵏ terms, each ≥ 1/2ᵏ⁺¹, so every block adds ≥ ½. infinitely many halves → ∞. □
